high.title: The 4 pillars supporting Vale (VALE3) in Empiricus' dividend portfolio
high.summary: Vale (VALE3) has returned to Empiricus' automated dividend portfolio in May, replacing SLC Agrícola (SLCE3) in a portfolio that has already delivered 28.7% returns in 2026 through April. Vale's inclusion is driven by consistent results evolution, particularly in its base metals division, which analysts call the "crown jewel." The company reported Q1 2026 net profit of R$ 1.9 billion, up 29% year-over-year. This is significant for BRL markets as Vale is a major component of the Ibovespa and a key export revenue generator for Brazil. Strong Vale performance typically supports BRL strength through improved trade balance dynamics and increased foreign investment flows. The base metals division's outperformance suggests resilient demand for Brazil's mining exports, which could provide continued support for the Real and government revenues. International fund managers should monitor Vale's performance as a bellwether for broader Brazilian equity market sentiment and currency stability.

medium.title: Bitcoin (BTC) loses $80,000 support amid inflation deterioration; see cryptocurrency prices this Thursday (14)
medium.summary: Bitcoin trades around $79,000 with a 1.5% decline in 24 hours as global crypto markets retreat following new US inflation data. The US PPI rose 1.4% quarterly and 6% annually in April - the largest increase since 2022, signaling corporate cost pressures are being passed to consumers amid the Iran conflict. This inflationary pressure could influence Federal Reserve policy, indirectly affecting emerging market flows including Brazil. Higher US rates typically strengthen the dollar against emerging market currencies like the BRL.
